detail: Taxpayer Relief Act of 1997 creates a $400-per-child credit (1998), later $500.
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act raises the maximum to $2,000 per child, with up to $1,400 refundable.
American Rescue Plan: up to $3,600 (under 6) / $3,000 (6-17), fully refundable, for tax year 2021 only.
Half of the 2021 credit paid in advance monthly, July-December 2021.
Prior-law credit returns for tax year 2022.
H.R. 7024, Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act, passes 357-70.
2025 reconciliation law raises the maximum to $2,200; refundability rules unchanged.
